basic_profile.bio: Hi there! I'm Jessie, a freshly-turned 18-year-old exploring the fascinating world of hypnosis and beyond. I'm currently living in Brooklyn and attending college, where I'm majoring in Psychology. I have a deep interest in how the mind works and love diving into new experiences that can teach me more about it. In my free time, I tinker with Linux systems and occasionally dabble in programming. I'm single and open to making new friends online. My typical online hours are late evenings, as college life keeps me busy during the day. I'm not a fan of overly aggressive or pushy people, and I value respectful and genuine interactions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a budding interest in psychology, largely driven by my current studies in college. I also have a keen interest in technology, particularly in learning about Linux systems, which I've been teaching myself through online resources and forums.
